rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: Citing the CEC protocol of 7 March 2008 on the results of the presidential election (74,746,649 voters took part; registered candidate Dmitry Anatolyevich Medvedev received 52,530,712 votes, 70.28 per cent, more than half of those voting), and Articles 19, 76 and 79 of the federal law on the election of the President, the CEC declares the election valid, deems Medvedev elected to the office of President of the Russian Federation and orders publication in Rossiyskaya gazeta, Parlamentskaya gazeta and the CEC Vestnik. Signed V. E. Churov (Chairman) and N. E. Konkin (Secretary), 7 March 2008, No. 104/777-5.
rows.locator: Resolution heading, preamble, points 1-3 and signature block
